title: Steam Review Scraper Input
description: Choose games by app ID, URL or name, then export reviews or a per-game summary.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: reviews = one row per review; gameSummary = one row per game with metadata and overall score.

appIds.title: Steam App IDs
appIds.description: Numeric app IDs, store URLs, community review URLs, or old appreviews URLs. Example: 1174180 or https://store.steampowered.com/app/1174180/

startUrls.title: Steam Game URLs (legacy)
startUrls.description: Steam store page URLs for the games to scrape. Merged with appIds.

gameNames.title: Game Names
gameNames.description: Search Steam by name. An exact case-insensitive title match is preferred over the first search result.

maxReviews.title: Max Reviews per Game
maxReviews.description: Reviews to collect per game. Use 0 for every matching review (hard safety cap 1,000,000 per game).

maxGames.title: Max Games
maxGames.description: Cap the merged game list. Use 0 for no cap.

language.title: Language
language.description: Steam language code for review text. Select All Languages to include every language.

sortBy.title: Sort
sortBy.description: recent and updated walk the full history; helpful is a ranked sample inside the helpfulness window; funny is also ranked and not exhaustive.

helpfulWithinDays.title: Helpful Window (days)
helpfulWithinDays.description: Only for sortBy=helpful: rank reviews from the last 1-365 days. Use recent for full history.

purchaseType.title: Purchase Type
purchaseType.description: Whether the reviewer acquired the game through Steam, outside Steam, or either.

minPlaytimeHours.title: Minimum Playtime (hours)
minPlaytimeHours.description: Minimum hours played at the time of review. Use 0 for no minimum.

maxPlaytimeHours.title: Maximum Playtime (hours)
maxPlaytimeHours.description: Maximum hours played at the time of review. Use 0 for no maximum.

steamDeckOnly.title: Steam Deck Only
steamDeckOnly.description: Only reviews written while playing primarily on a Steam Deck.

includeOffTopic.title: Include Off-Topic Reviews
includeOffTopic.description: Include reviews Steam hides as off-topic review-bomb activity. Off by default, matching the store.

useReviewQuality.title: Use Review Quality Ranking
useReviewQuality.description: Only for sortBy=helpful: rank low-quality reviews lower.

reviewsFromDate.title: Reviews From (YYYY-MM-DD)
reviewsFromDate.description: Include reviews created on or after this UTC date.

reviewsToDate.title: Reviews To (YYYY-MM-DD)
reviewsToDate.description: Include reviews created on or before this UTC date.

includeGameDetails.title: Attach Game Details
includeGameDetails.description: mode=reviews: attach game metadata, price and overall review summary to every review row.
